title: What does a scanned PDF say underneath? Its hidden text layer, read without a PDF library

steps.note: read.mjs, core.mjs, fixture.mjs, test.mjs (20 checks, four broken on purpose, each red where I guessed) and a face that reads a PDF in the browser. Looking at the face found a bug node couldn't: the core's show() and the page's show() collided, 0 words in red; check 18 runs the face's own script and failed on it first. First uses: Bedfordshire Archaeology 24 on Wrest Park (the Leg O'Mutton's D-shaped extension still there in 1988) and JSS 88 on the Thai calendar (24:00 as the usual Thai moment for a date's value).
